msgs.text: Genera 5 imágenes separadas con Nano Banana 2.1, cada una en su formato y con su referencia (las referencias están adjuntas). Usa los textos tal cual, sin reescribirlos ni añadir nada. REGLA A: Reproduce the EXACT product from the reference image: identical shape, proportions, materials, colours, stones and details; do not redesign it. Leave out any hands, price tags, stickers, shop text and the original background. Photorealistic, high-end commercial photography, natural skin texture, crisp material detail, no text, no letters, no watermark, no logos, no brand names, no frames, no collage, no words or labels anywhere in the image. IMAGEN 1 «h» (formato 16:9, referencia lanas-paloma-26.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Boutique campaign still life of skeins of silky mohair yarn with sequins in mustard, orange and brown from the reference. The product sits in the right third of the frame and the scene continues to the left, softly out of focus and calm, with room for a headline. Warm natural light, soft textures. One single continuous photograph, never a split screen or collage. IMAGEN 2 «p1» (formato 3:4, referencia lanas-paloma-26.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo of a skein of silky mohair yarn with tiny sequins in chocolate brown, no label from the reference, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#F1ECE5) background with a soft shadow, crisp detail. IMAGEN 3 «p2» (formato 3:4, referencia lanas-paloma-30.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo of a skein of lilac mohair yarn and a cake of mauve cotton yarn, no labels from the reference, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#F1ECE5) background with a soft shadow, crisp detail. IMAGEN 4 «p3» (formato 3:4, referencia lanas-paloma-34.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo of spools of cotton cord yarn with sequins in blue and lime green, no labels from the reference, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#F1ECE5) background with a soft shadow, crisp detail. IMAGEN 5 «p4» (formato 3:4, referencia lanas-paloma-21.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo of cones of metallic silver and gold raffia yarn from the reference, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#F1ECE5) background with a soft shadow, crisp detail.
